subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should post-core plugin update and convergence evaluate plugin API compatibility against the installed target package version during current-process updates?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive compatibility source-of-truth choice: the code change is narrow and consistent with the fresh-process path, but it can change which external plugins are considered compatible before restart.

options.title: Accept target-version source
options.body: Merge after normal refresh/CI if maintainers agree the installed package is the version the restarted gateway will run and should drive post-core plugin compatibility.

options.title: Keep downgrade-only behavior
options.body: Ask for rework or close this PR if maintainers want current-process upgrades to keep using the running module version except for downgrade safety.

options.title: Require broader proof first
options.body: Pause until the contributor or maintainer proves a full npm-global update and decides how the Linux/systemd unknown-host runtime variant should be tracked.

recommendation.title: Accept target-version source
recommendation.body: Merge after normal refresh/CI if maintainers agree the installed package is the version the restarted gateway will run and should drive post-core plugin compatibility.
